summary: Found and fixed four defects in quayside (idempotency key ignored schema version, heartbeat interval used the global visibility, throttled results counted as failures, unknown payload fields were refused); wrote deadletter-report.json with per-defect counts measured by replaying the logs with one fix at a time. The 8 attempts-exhausted dead letters at 12:24-12:38 on June 8 came from an earlier release's constant backoff and are not counted.
